rows.corpus_definition: To run away from a dangerous place or person.
rows.example_en: Many people had to flee their homes during war.

rows.corpus_definition: The soft part of an animal or person under the skin.
rows.example_en: This fruit has sweet, soft flesh inside.

rows.corpus_definition: A large group of birds or sheep together.
rows.example_en: A flock of birds flew over us.

rows.corpus_definition: Traditional stories and beliefs shared by a group of people.
rows.example_en: The villagers enjoy sharing ancient local folklore.

rows.corpus_definition: to shape metal by heating it, or to make a fake copy of something
rows.example_en: Someone tried to forge his signature on the document.

rows.corpus_definition: The act of stopping your anger toward someone for their bad actions.
rows.example_en: He asked for her forgiveness after the argument.

rows.corpus_definition: The process of something starting to exist or be created.
rows.example_en: Scientists studied the early making of these mountain rocks.

rows.corpus_definition: A strong building designed to protect soldiers during a war.
rows.example_en: The soldiers stood guard at the old stone fort.

rows.corpus_definition: To start a new organization or build a place.
rows.example_en: They decided to found a new company together.

rows.corpus_definition: A small part or amount of something.
rows.example_en: Only a small fraction of the students passed today.
